propositions: Dense multi-criterion completion verification runs exhaust the bounded request budget with zero incremental criterion verdict banks, violating the documented banking contract.
Pydantic AI executes model response tool batches concurrently, so prompt-only instructions cannot enforce serialized evidence collection and record commits before budget exhaustion.

A finite-state banking enforcement wrapper at the agent tool seam atomically governs one repository action per response, counts unique evidence calls per criterion, and invokes provisional met=false banking on the third evidence response if the criterion remains unbanked.

The completion-only policy metadata and wrapper are composed between memo and runaway-guard layers for primary and successor paths, remaining private and invisible to unflagged callers and existing tool schemas.

The held-out dense oracle demonstrated bounded success 0/3 (RED) with policy disabled, 2+ of 3 (GREEN) with policy enabled, and the simple three-criterion control consistently banked 3/3 and returned PASS, confirming the isolated root cause and repair.
